overview: Host John Petrella interviews Robert Delafano, Chair of the Medford Licensing Commission, regarding the commission's roles and responsibilities in Medford. Delafano outlines the types of liquor licenses, application processes, local fee structures, renewal rules, and compliance enforcement.

items.title: Guest Introduction and Personal Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduces Robert Delafano, Chairperson of the Medford Licensing Commission, who discusses his background as a lifelong Medford resident, retired firefighter, and community volunteer.

items.title: Licensing Commission Operations and Composition
items.summary: Delafano outlines the commission's monthly public meeting schedule, introduces fellow commissioners and administrative staff, and shares statement excerpts emphasizing support for local business growth.

items.title: License Classifications, Application Steps, and Fees
items.summary: Delafano explains retail alcohol categories, Section 12 on-premise, Section 14 one-day, and Section 15 package store licenses, along with state application procedures and municipal fee schedules.

items.title: Enforcement, Compliance Checks, and Renewal Deadlines
items.summary: Delafano describes police compliance checks, strict state renewal deadlines, common violation types, and mandatory annual educational sessions for liquor licensees.

items.title: License Transfers and Quotas
items.summary: Delafano details the process for transferring existing liquor licenses during business sales and explains how population quotas affect license availability.
